# Generated by Suite Builder. EDIT RULES: do not edit this file; regenerating replaces all of it. A command of your own: a new file beside this one, which a rebuild leaves alone.
description: Turn the stories in stories/new/ into tests, or push each back saying exactly what is needed
argument-hint: [a story file or id; none: every story waiting]
---

Work on this suite's stories exactly as stories/AI-INSTRUCTIONS.md says; read it first, and ai/AI-README.md.

- $ARGUMENTS names one story (a file in stories/new/ or stories/done/, or its id): work on that one only.
  Nothing named: every file in stories/new/, then every story in stories/done/ with an `Answer:` line
  under its `Not implemented:` lines.
- For each: implement it (one test per acceptance criterion, `<id>-<n>`) or push it back, never both,
  and never guess to make a story fit.
- Nothing that sends a form, orders, signs up or emails someone, unless the team rules in
  ai/AI-README.md allow it.
- Before you report, run `mvn -o -q test-compile`, then `mvn -o test -Dtest=SuiteRulesTest` (offline, no browser) and fix what they find.
- Report as a table: each story, what you did (implemented, pushed back, waiting on its person), the
  tests written, and what each pushed-back story needs. Then the commands that run the new tests in a
  browser, `mvn test -Dtest=<TestClass>`, if you could not run them here.
